releases.notes:
## Autobattle Mod for Cobblemon v1.0.0

> First public release!

### What's included
- Fully automated Cobblemon Battle Clone NPC grinder
- State machine: FIND_TARGET ? INTERACT ? WAIT_FOR_BATTLE ? IN_BATTLE ? BATTLE_ENDED ? HEAL
- Headless action submitter (works even when BattleGUI is closed)
- Auto move selection with configurable slots
- Auto-heal via Cobblemon Smartphone mod
- Toggle keybind (U key, rebindable)
- Full `/autobattle` command tree
- JSON config with live reload

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.1 + Fabric Loader ? 0.15.0
- Cobblemon 1.7.3+1.21.1
- Cobblemon Secret Base Trainer 1.14.29
- Cobblemon Smartphone 1.0.7 _(optional, for auto-heal)_

### Installation
Drop `autobattle-cobblemon-1.0.0.jar` into your `.minecraft/mods/` folder.

See [README](https://github.com/Anton-gil/autobattle_mod_Minecraft_cobblemon#readme) for full usage and command docs.
